sources.label: CPWD Plinth Area Rates 2025 — methodology reference, not a Pune product price list

scope.structure: Area allowance for foundations, RCC frame, slabs and stair structure; excludes masonry, finishes and MEP. Not a concrete or steel take-off.
scope.rates: Installed material + labour allowances, before contractor overhead and GST. GST is excluded by default; the optional provision is not tax advice.
excluded: Land, approvals, financing and unusual ground works
Loose furniture, appliances, modular kitchen, wardrobes, HVAC, lift and solar
Unmeasured exterior facade features, compound wall/gate, service connections and decorative landscaping
included: Concept structure allowance, measured walls, plaster and selected finishes
Door leaves and glazing from actual openings, roof waterproofing
Area-based electrical and plumbing allowances; planned paving, lawn and pool where present
